results.title: Bayer faces pivotal test of $7.25 billion Roundup settlement in Missouri court
results.description: Bayer's Monsanto unit heads to a Missouri state court on Monday seeking ​approval of a $7.25 billion settlement that could resolve tens of thousands of U.S. lawsuits alleging that its popular weedkiller Roundup ‌causes cancer.

results.title: Russian power for Air Kerala: Agreement reached to purchase 20 aircraft
results.description: NEW DELHI: Reports say Indian companies have started taking steps to purchase more than 100 aircraft from Russia. Air Kerala is also said to be among the companies involved, according to an English media. During the Inno prom exhibition held in Delhi, Indian companies reached agreements to purchase 105 small aircraft.

results.title: Green Stocks Sep 11- BRICS In Delhi Brings Hope As Markets Pull Back From Lows
results.description: The start of the BRICS summit in Delhi brought some hope of a positive news for India, especially vis a vis relations with China, but overall market response remained muted, weighed down by events elsewhere. Oil is truly on a boil, and that can't be good for India or most of South Asia and the many countries that are significant importers. For the green pack, it is the belief that the government's backing for the green sector will remain strong, along with the increasing proof of delivery in terms of rising manufacturing capacity and installations that inspire optimism. With the Chinese President in India after six years, any softening of ties, especially business to business exchanges where Chinese restrictions have thrown many plans haywire especially in the battery manufacturing space, would be welcomed. Of course, don't expect any wholesale changes in approach, as that is simply not how the Chinese think, or work. In stock specific action, it was the strong support for CleanMax, Emmvee and Acme Solar that continued to stand out, even as Alpex Solar's solar cell plant in UP, set to be inaugurated in the coming week, provided some much needed support for the stock. The broader picture continues to remain one of caution, as investors await clearer signals of stability and moderation in the global situation to place larger, more long term conviction bets.
